results.timing_scope: CPU batch 1, one thread. Resident raw waveform to free-running native transcription; fbank, normalization, caches, A2 head, decoder, conversion/Python overhead included. Model load and reference metrics excluded; file IO additionally reported. No microphone waiting/display latency.
results.decoder_scope: Each recognizer uses its own native ONNX prediction network/joiner and tokens. A2 and teacher share native decoder weights; A2 loads/runs no teacher encoder. A2 frontend/head use FP32 ONNX first/step exports; training/selection used the numerically checked PyTorch implementation.
results.limitations: Single seed; reused project dev roles, no test split. Small recognizer uses native 39-frame window versus 45 for teacher/A2; all hop 32 frames. All measured neural paths use ONNX CPU. Two timing repetitions do not establish hardware-wide uncertainty.

cfg.experiment: A2 audio-only MAE then KL qualification
cfg.representation_gate: Best MAE checkpoint must beat the train-mean constant on the same fixed model-selection windows; otherwise report representation-stage failure and skip KL
cfg.checkpoint_selection: MAE stage by representation MAE; KL stage and final candidate by free-running dev-clean WER on the model-selection role
cfg.sampling: Per utterance/epoch: start window 1/8, end window 1/8, random window 6/8; no excluded burn-in chunks; causal past features only
cfg.cost_rule: Require at most half of both same-run complete teacher cost and recorded previous complete teacher cost on dev-clean; report each denominator
cfg.scope: One-seed local 100h correction/distillation run. Teacher and small public recognizer have separate upstream training. No FGN/B/C training or adaptive fallback. Qualification is not teacher-WER parity.
